q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Wang Lin. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in the south-west of China. I live with my parents and my little brother. I like my maths teacher, Mr Zhang, because he explains things clearly and he often tells funny stories in class. I use my mobile phone every day after school, mostly to chat with my friends, but I don’t use it during lessons. I like spring the most, because the weather is warm and there are flowers everywhere. I prefer the afternoon, because I’m not so sleepy and I can do sports after school. I love table tennis and football. I play table tennis with my dad at the weekend. I usually listen to pop music, especially Chinese pop songs, because they make me feel happy. In the school holidays I read books, visit my grandparents in the countryside and sometimes travel with my family.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都用完整句子作答，并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…, especially…），能正确使用一般现在时，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see two girls and two horses in the countryside. The girl at the front is wearing a blue jacket, dark trousers and long boots. She’s walking along a grassy path and she’s leading a big brown horse. Behind her there’s another girl with long blonde hair. She’s wearing a white top and she’s standing near another horse in the field. It’s probably summer, because the grass is green and there are lots of white flowers. In the background I can see some tall trees and two red wooden houses, so maybe it’s a farm. The sky is blue with some clouds. I think the girls live on the farm and they’re taking care of the horses. They look calm and happy.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要涵盖人物（在做什么、穿什么）、地点和其他物品，并用 I think / maybe / probably 进行合理推测；不会的词可以换种说法，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. The internet is very useful, because you can find information quickly and it’s free. Magazines are good too, because they show the latest fashion, but they only show new clothes. I think a fashion show would be exciting, but you’re right, it’s expensive and it’s not easy to get tickets. A museum is a great idea, because the project could compare old clothes and modern clothes. I’m not sure about making clothes – it takes a long time and it’s quite difficult. Looking in shop windows is easy, but you can’t get much information. In my opinion, the museum is the best, because they can learn a lot and take notes. But the internet is good too. Shall we choose the internet then? OK, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），主动谈到其他方式，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的方式。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I enjoy going shopping for clothes with my mum, because I like choosing new colours and styles. At weekends I usually wear jeans and a T-shirt, because they’re comfortable and I can play sports in them. I’ve never made my own clothes, because I can’t use a sewing machine, but I’d like to try one day. In China, people often wear red clothes for special occasions like Chinese New Year, because red means good luck. I think what people wear is quite important, because clothes show your personality. But I don’t think people should spend too much money on expensive clothes.
